corrections.title: Add 5v5 Jawas defence with solo Darth Malak and solo Kylo Ren counters
corrections.rationale: Chief Nebit-led Jawas (Chief Nebit, Dathcha, Jawa, Jawa Engineer, Jawa Scavenger) has no 5v5 row. Owner review of 13 October 2026 approved original Kylo Ren solo and Darth Malak solo in principle; this adds them plus the new KYLO_REN_SOLO counter definition. Tier, score and notes are authoring proposals, not measured average banners.

evidence.supports: NOT VERIFIED: the agent could not obtain matchup-specific evidence for Jawas from SWGOH.GG; the issue cites a small historical 5v5 sample that has not been independently verified, and the draft's placeholder URLs/dates were not adopted.

provenance.conditions: 5v5 only. Jawas = Chief Nebit, Dathcha, Jawa, Jawa Engineer, Jawa Scavenger. Solo attackers: Darth Malak; original Kylo Ren (not Unmasked or SLKR). Relics, datacron and game version not verified.
provenance.confidence: Low until matchup-specific evidence is obtained.
provenance.limitations: Small historical 5v5 samples only; bannerScore 61/60 are base full-team-equivalent estimates excluding the undersize premium (undersize 4 is the separate solo signal). Kylo is conditional on strong relics and surviving thermal detonators.
